image_space: original RGB pixels; no crop, undistortion, or geometric calibration applied
overlap_policy: Only sidewalk candidates are generated and unioned. No other class can overwrite them. Unassigned pixels remain ignore 255, not verified negatives.
development_note: Fixed single-concept diagnostic, not an approved full-dataset recipe. Unlike v9, this changes the detector input as well as composition. Unlike v2, it excludes synonyms/curb-ramp prompts and never composes twelve classes. No corrected pixels, per-image points, filenames, or reference-selected candidates enter inference. Shadow, driveway, and actual obstacle errors still require review.
